# CacheLane — local cache-discipline layer for Claude Code

> A local HTTP proxy, MCP server, and Claude Code hooks that mark prompt-cache
> breakpoints and prune idle tool output. On this host it also fronts LiteLLM.

## Knowledge index — start here

- [.okf/index.md](.okf/index.md): in-repo knowledge catalog.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): operator and history routing table.

## Repo entry points

- [README.md](README.md): npm-user overview, install, usage (does not reorder).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent operating conventions for this repo.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude shim; imports AGENTS.md.
